map.→ 打开冷却换热功率计算工具: -> Open the cooling heat transfer power calculator tool
map.冷却换热功率计算 使用指南: How to use the cooling heat transfer power calculator
map.变温换热应用对数平均温差 LMTD，单值 ΔT 仅适合近似或恒温热源。: For variable-temperature heat transfer apply the log mean temperature difference (LMTD); a single ΔT value is only an approximation or suited to an isothermal heat source.
map.填写「目标功率 P (kW，反算水量)」。: Enter the "target power P (kW, back-calculated water flow)".
map.换热器按传热系数、面积与温差估算换热量。: Estimate the heat transfer of an exchanger from the coefficient, area and temperature difference.
map.校核冷却能力是否满足热负荷。: Check whether the cooling capacity meets the thermal load.
map.用温差还是对数温差？: Use the temperature difference or the log mean difference?
map.由两侧对流与壁面导热串联估算，污垢热阻也要计入。: Estimated as convection on both sides in series with conduction through the wall, with the fouling thermal resistance also counted.
map.管径计算（重力流/压力流）: Pipe diameter calculation (gravity flow / pressure flow)
map.输入载冷剂流量与进、出口温差，按比热容计算换热功率（kW），并可反算维持该冷量所: Enter the coolant flow and the inlet/outlet temperature difference to compute the cooling power (kW) from the specific heat capacity, and back-calculate the cooling water flow needed to sustain that cooling load, for load matching and equipment selection in central and industrial cooling systems.
map.选型时比面积与流速对换热的影响。: The effect of area ratio and velocity on heat transfer during selection.
map.：k=10 W/㎡·K、A=5 ㎡、ΔT=1000 K（如油/水大温差示意）→: : k=10 W/m2.K, A=5 m2, ΔT=1000 K (as an illustration of a large oil/water difference) -> Q=10x5x1000=50,000 W=50 kW.
map.：ΔT 从 1000 降到 800，换热量同比例降 20%，端差设计很关键。: : dropping ΔT from 1000 to 800 lowers the heat transfer by 20% proportionally, so the approach temperature design matters a lot.
